morphology.pattern_note: 词根末尾 /n/ 保留，-nya 读 /ɲa/，音节为 ma.kan.nya。-nya 可参与名词化，并依语境关联某人的进食。按要求保留输入中的词根爪夷文；完整词形可写作 ماکنڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 某人的进食行为、食量或进食方式，具体侧重点由上下文决定。
senses.en_definition: A person's eating, including their manner of eating or food intake.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan, cara atau banyaknya seseorang makan, mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: makannya 是 makan 与 -nya 的组合，不能一律等同于 makanan“食物”。例如 cara makannya 指“他的吃相或进食方式”。-nya 的名词化功能参见 [DBP 语法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penekan)。本条为综合释义，并非输入所附词根定义的逐字引用。

collocations.zh: 他的进食方式；他的吃相
collocations.en: the way he or she eats
his or her eating is irregular

senses.zh_definition: 某人的膳食、伙食供给或吃饭方面的开支。
senses.en_definition: A person's meals, food provision, or meal expenses.
senses.nuances: 承接 makan 可指生计或饮食需要的名词用法，常见于说明由谁负担伙食。它并不直接指某一道食物。makannya 也不应与表示“所以”的 makanya 混同；原句若表达因果关系，应另行核查拼写。

collocations.en: his or her meals are covered
his or her meals are assured

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Sepanjang kursus tersebut, makannya ditanggung sepenuhnya oleh pihak penganjur.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在该课程期间，他的伙食由主办方全额承担。
dual_scenarios.en: His meals are fully covered by the organiser throughout the course.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tengok cara makannya, berselera betul dia hari ni!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Lihat cara makannya; dia benar-benar berselera pada hari ini!
dual_scenarios.zh: 看他吃得那个香，今天胃口真好！
dual_scenarios.en: Look at him eat—he's really enjoying his food today!
spoken_features: tengok 是常用口语词，正式表达可用 lihat
ni 是 ini 的口语形式
先描述状态，再补出主语 dia

messages.speaker: Farah (家人)
messages.ms_spoken: Tengok cara makannya, berselera betul dia hari ni! Dah tambah nasi ke?
messages.ms_standard: Lihat cara makannya; dia benar-benar berselera pada hari ini! Adakah dia sudah menambah nasi?
messages.zh: 看他吃得多香，今天胃口真好！已经添过饭了吗？
messages.en: Look at him eat—he's really enjoying it today! Has he had more rice already?

messages.speaker: Amir (家人)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, sikit je. Lepas ni dia nak tambah lauk pula.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, tetapi sedikit sahaja. Selepas ini, dia hendak menambah lauk pula.
messages.zh: 添过了，就一点。等下他还想再添点菜。
messages.en: Yes, just a little. Now he wants another helping of the dishes.

etymology.historical_story: Makannya combines the everyday Malay base makan with -nya; it does not require a separate borrowing history. Eating supplies a natural bridge between an action and its practical support. Consequently, context can shift attention from how someone eats to who provides their meals. This is why cara makannya and makannya ditanggung belong to related but distinct uses.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: makan 是“吃”，makannya 把镜头对准“某人的吃”：cara makannya 看怎么吃，makannya ditanggung 看谁包伙食。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 评论别人的 cara makannya 可能被理解为批评吃相。与不熟悉的人共餐时，宜避免直接评价其食量或礼仪；表示食物好吃，可说 Sedap makanannya。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用于家庭聊天、饮食习惯描述及伙食安排。正式说明费用时，可写 kos makan ditanggung，以明确是费用承担；邀请别人用餐则用 Jemput makan。
